name: Vase Showcase
description: Auto-playing product slider card where a colored panel wipes down to switch between items, showing the name, tagline, image and a row of five spec columns, with dot navigation.
contents: Product card with two-part title and tagline
Spec panel with five value and label columns
behavior: Autoplays to the next item after a delay
Item color overlay slides down, content fades out and swaps, then fades back in
Dots jump to a chosen item and are ignored during a transition
editableByProps: Items, names, taglines, colors, images and specs
Page, text and spec panel colors as Tailwind classes

needsCodeEdit.where: The useEffect with the swap and done timeouts and the overlay translate classes
h-[520px] and max-w-[640px] classes on the card div

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Exactly five specs per item fit the spec panel layout
Colors are Tailwind class strings, not hex values
